_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV : revenu total (taille pharma+crop+CH), structure segments en story Crop dominante.

kpis.signal: Pic 2022 (50.7 Mds) sur prix glyphosate eleves + reprise pharma. Decrue continue depuis sur normalisation Crop + perte exclusivite Xarelto
kpis.description_fr: CA consolide Bayer AG. Mix segments : Crop Science (~49%) + Pharmaceuticals (~38%) + Consumer Health (~13%).
kpis.description_en: Bayer AG consolidated revenue. Segment mix: Crop Science (~49%) + Pharmaceuticals (~38%) + Consumer Health (~13%).

kpis_story.description_fr: Crop Science = 48.8% du CA 2023. #1 mondial semences (Monsanto integration) + agrochimie. Pression litiges Roundup/glyphosate provisions cumulees ~16 Mds USD.
kpis_story.description_en: Crop Science = 48.8% of 2023 revenue. #1 global seeds (Monsanto integration) + crop protection. Roundup/glyphosate litigation pressure cumulative provisions ~$16B.

kpis_story.description_fr: Xarelto (anticoagulant) + Eylea (ophtalmologie) = piliers pharma Bayer. Xarelto perd exclusivite progressivement 2024-2027 (cliff revenu). Pipeline successeur : asundexian + finerenone.
kpis_story.description_en: Xarelto (anticoagulant) + Eylea (ophthalmology) = Bayer pharma pillars. Xarelto loses exclusivity 2024-2027 (revenue cliff). Successor pipeline: asundexian + finerenone.

_notes: Segment revenue Pharmaceuticals/Crop Science/Consumer Health 5 ans + Xarelto/Eylea sales 5 ans non extractibles sans rapport annuel detaille. Wikipedia mix 2023 uniquement (48.8% / 38.0% / 12.7%). 2020 manquant (stockanalysis tronque).
